test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an amendment made to the Airport Economic Regulatory Authority (AERA) Amendment Act, 2021?

options.text: The government can call any airport a major airport just by notification.
The government will club together profit-making and loss-making airports.
The government can offer airports as a package in PPP mode to the prospective bidders.
A major airport is one which has an annual traffic of minimum 35 lakh passengers.

solution:
The correct answer is __**A major airport is one which has an annual traffic of minimum 35 lakh passengers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On March 24, 2021, the Lok Sabha received the Airports Economic Regulatory Authority of India (Amendment) Bill, 2021.
 
• The 2008 Airports Economic Regulatory Authority of India Act is being modified.
 
• The Airport Economic Regulatory Authority was founded under the 2008 Act.
 
• AERA regulates tariffs and other charges (such as airport development fees) for aeronautical services rendered at major airports in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A major airport is one that receives at least 35 lakh passengers annually, according to the 2008 Act.
 
• Any airport may be designated as a major airport by notification from the federal government.
 
• According to the Bill, the federal government may group airports and declare the group to be a major airport.
